description: Figure 6 is a bar chart that illustrates the average number of tokens under different numbers of shots with few-shot style. The x-axis represents the number of shots, ranging from 0 to 4. The y-axis represents the average number of tokens, with values ranging from 0 to 7000. The bars are color-coded to represent different few-shot styles: zero-shot (blue), one-shot (red), and few-shot (purple). The chart shows that as the number of shots increases, the average number of tokens decreases, with the few-shot style having the fewest tokens.
